setup: You are considering a short-term put option before the market fully reacts to the sales outlook.
decision_prompt: Your bank starts at $10,000. Run the mini-simulator, compare its estimate with the market option price, then decide whether to take this option or skip it. If you take it, choose how much of your bank to invest.
post_event_outcome: Nike suffered a major drop after forecasting a surprise annual sales decline and raising concerns about its turnaround.
explanation: This scenario is based on a real market event, but the option inputs and trade return are simplified for learning. Even famous brands can fall sharply when investors lose confidence in future growth.
lesson: Even famous brands can fall sharply when investors lose confidence in future growth.
simplification_note: Event is real; option inputs, market option price, and option return are educational simplifications rather than exact historical option-chain data.
take_confirmation_prompt: Choose how much of your bank to invest in this option.
